description: This file contains implementations related to XNNPACK-based convolution and transposed convolution operations within the ATen/native/XNNPack namespace for PyTorch, including functions for creating, checking availability, reordering weights, and executing convolution operations.

classes.name: ContextConv2D
classes.description: A class encapsulating the operator context for 2D convolution or transposed convolution in XNNPACK, including the operator handle, weight size, padding, output padding, stride, dilation, transposed flag, and groups.

classes.name: Conv2dOpContext
classes.description: A class representing prepacked convolution operator context for standard 2D convolutions, used for efficient repeated execution.

classes.name: TransposeConv2dOpContext
classes.description: A class representing prepacked transposed convolution operator context for efficient repeated execution.

methods.description: Checks whether the current environment and parameters support XNNPACK convolution.

methods.name: ContextConv2D create(const Tensor & weight,const std::optional<Tensor> & bias,const IntArrayRef padding,const IntArrayRef output_padding,const IntArrayRef stride,const IntArrayRef dilation,const int64_t groups,const bool transposed,const float output_min,const float output_max)
methods.description: Creates a convolution or deconvolution context with specified parameters, including weight, bias, padding, output padding, stride, dilation, groups, transposed flag, output min and max.

methods.name: Tensor run(ContextConv2D & context,const Tensor & input)
methods.description: Executes the convolution or transposed convolution operation given the context and input tensor.

methods.description: Creates a prepacked convolution operation context with clamping (min/max).

methods.description: Creates a prepacked transposed convolution operation context with clamping.

methods.description: Runs the prepacked convolution operation with clamp.

methods.description: Unpacks and retrieves the size and bias information from a prepacked conv2d operator IValue.

methods.description: Determines if convolution2d operation is supported for the given parameters and input.
